text: 1 days ago LeBron's legacy is already set. If he wanted to step away from basketball today, he'd always be remembered as one of the greatest to ever play the game. Regardless if you love him or hate him, you can't deny the fact that he's on the Mount Rushmore of basketball. 4x Champion, 4x Finals MVP, 4x MVP, most all-time career points. He's won a championship with 3 different franchises. He's played alongside his son. LeBron James has done literally everything you could possibly do in this game, and then some. Read full article
